summary: Retrieve item details using a legacy ID
description: This method is a bridge between the eBay legacy APIs and the eBay Buy APIs. It lets you use legacy item ids to retrieve the details of a specific item and its RESTful item ID.

parameters.name: fieldgroups
parameters.description: Control what is returned. Only value supported is PRODUCT.

parameters.name: legacy_item_id
parameters.description: The legacy item ID of an item or a group parent.

parameters.name: legacy_variation_id
parameters.description: Legacy ID of a specific item variation.

parameters.name: legacy_variation_sku
parameters.description: Legacy SKU created by the seller.
